propositions: Operator-attested evidence currently lacks provenance fields (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument), allowing attestations from wrong accounts and under overprivileged principals to pass the gate undetected

The existing contract demands only attestation-event provenance (change id / vote / timestamp) but never validates measurement context, creating escape hatches where cached measurements from different environments or broader-privilege identities satisfy the criteria without indicating real-world feasibility

A new deterministic check module (det_measurement_provenance.py) must validate presence and non-placeholder form of four required provenance fields—environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument—alongside their enum membership, making no semantic judgment of correctness

The amended evidence contract must be enforced via project overlay (not shipped defaults) with an AGENT-tier criterion that reads in-repo anchors (e.g., Terraform backend account) to detect declared-vs-repository contradictions, particularly for authorization claims under simulation vs live-call instruments

Declaration syntax is a mandatory continuation line indented under [operator-attested] checkbox, pinned to single-line form with em-dash-separated justification, enforced as ADVISORY to avoid breaking pre-contract tickets

Pre-existing [operator-attested] criteria without provenance fields must be grandfathered as coaching strings rather than failures, and the shipped contract text (F1/E2/E6/coach_moves.py) remains byte-identical to preserve cross-client consistency
